description: Search, read, label, archive, draft, send and trash email in a connected Gmail account.
name: Gmail

tools.description: Add labels to every message of a Gmail thread (STARRED to star it, IMPORTANT, or the user's own).

label_ids.description: Label ids from gmail.list_labels: the user's own (Label_12) or system ones such as STARRED, IMPORTANT, UNREAD (remove it to mark as read) or INBOX. Not TRASH or SPAM: use gmail.trash.
label_ids.title: Label Ids

tools.name: add_labels
tools.title: Add email labels

tools.description: Archive a Gmail thread: it leaves the inbox and stays in All Mail.
tools.name: archive
tools.title: Archive an email thread

tools.description: Save a plain-text draft in the connected Gmail account, new or as a reply in a thread (reply_to_thread_id). Nothing is sent: the person sends it from Gmail.

body.description: The message, as plain text or Markdown.
body.title: Body

format.description: plain (the default): the body is sent as written. markdown: also send it formatted, from simple Markdown only (# headings, - and 1. lists, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [text](https://…)). HTML in the body is sent as text, never as HTML.
format.title: Format

reply_to_thread_id.description: To reply in a thread: its threadId. The reply answers the thread's newest message.
reply_to_thread_id.title: Reply To Thread Id

subject.description: One line. For a reply, the thread's subject with 'Re: ' in front, so Gmail keeps it in the thread.
subject.title: Subject

tools.name: create_draft
tools.title: Draft an email

tools.description: List the drafts in the connected Gmail mailbox, newest first: draftId, to, cc, bcc, subject and a snippet. Use them with gmail.send_draft.
tools.name: list_drafts
tools.title: List email drafts

tools.description: List the connected Gmail mailbox's labels (system ones such as INBOX, and the user's own).

inputSchema.description: The args model for a tool that takes no arguments.
inputSchema.title: NoArgs

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: List email labels

tools.description: Read one attachment of a Gmail message as text: plain text, CSV, JSON, XML or HTML, up to 100 000 characters. Give the message id and the attachment's `part` from gmail.read_thread. PDFs, images and Office files can't be read.

message_id.description: The message's id (`id` of a message in gmail.read_thread).
message_id.title: Message Id

part.description: The attachment's `part` as gmail.read_thread lists it, like 1 or 0.2.
part.title: Part

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.title: Read an email attachment

tools.description: Read every message of one Gmail thread as plain text, with its main headers and its attachments (name, type, size and part: read a text one with gmail.read_attachment). Quoted earlier mail at the end of a reply is left out. Long threads are cut, oldest messages first.
tools.name: read_thread
tools.title: Read an email thread

tools.description: Remove labels from every message of a Gmail thread (UNREAD to mark it read, STARRED to unstar).

label_ids.description: Label ids from gmail.list_labels: the user's own (Label_12) or system ones such as STARRED, IMPORTANT, UNREAD (remove it to mark as read) or INBOX. Not TRASH or SPAM: use gmail.trash.
label_ids.title: Label Ids

tools.name: remove_labels
tools.title: Remove email labels

tools.description: Search the connected Gmail mailbox with a Gmail query. Returns up to 25 messages: id, threadId, from, to, subject, date, labels and a short snippet. Use gmail.read_thread with a threadId to read the full conversation.

query.description: A Gmail search query, as typed in Gmail's search box: from:sara@acme.dev, to:me, subject:invoice, "exact words", newer_than:7d, after:2026/11/01, is:unread, label:Invoices, has:attachment, in:inbox. Combine with spaces (AND) or OR.
query.title: Query

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search email

tools.description: Send a plain-text email from the connected Gmail account, new or as a reply in a thread (reply_to_thread_id). At most 20 recipients.

body.description: The message, as plain text or Markdown.
body.title: Body

format.description: plain (the default): the body is sent as written. markdown: also send it formatted, from simple Markdown only (# headings, - and 1. lists, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [text](https://…)). HTML in the body is sent as text, never as HTML.
format.title: Format

reply_to_thread_id.description: To reply in a thread: its threadId. The reply answers the thread's newest message.
reply_to_thread_id.title: Reply To Thread Id

subject.description: One line. For a reply, the thread's subject with 'Re: ' in front, so Gmail keeps it in the thread.
subject.title: Subject

tools.name: send
tools.title: Send an email

tools.description: Send a draft that is already in Gmail. Give its draftId and, exactly as gmail.list_drafts shows them, its recipients (plain addresses) and subject: the person approves those, and nothing is sent if the draft doesn't match.

subject.description: The draft's subject, as gmail.list_drafts shows it.
subject.title: Subject

tools.name: send_draft
tools.title: Send an email draft

tools.description: Move a Gmail thread to Trash. Gmail deletes it for good after 30 days.
tools.name: trash
tools.title: Move an email thread to Trash

triggers.description: When a new email reaches the inbox, the bot gets a message in your chat with it and reads the email. Not for your own sent mail, drafts, Promotions or Social.
triggers.name: new_email
triggers.title: React to new email
